name: Thorns of Fate: Reborn to Take It All Back
original_name: 命运之棘：重生夺回一切
overview: In the previous life, Grace and Nina grew up in the same orphanage. When fate offered them a choice, Nina chose the wealthy Grants, while Grace was taken by janitors. But Victor Grant fell for Grace instead, and on their wedding day, Nina's rage ended them both. Given a second chance at life, Nina seizes Grace's path, only to fall into a darker hell. Grace rewrites her fate-rising from shadows with talent, courage, and her own hard-won power.  (Source: DramaBoxdb)
